remarks:
Discover 73.8 acres of picturesque Western New York countryside nestled in the rolling hills of Little Valley, just minutes from Ellicottville. Offering a beautiful combination of agricultural fields, mature woodlands, spectacular hilltop views, and outstanding recreational opportunities, this property presents an exceptional setting for a private country estate, hunting retreat, or agricultural investment. he property features a 1.6-acre road-frontage potential building lot, offering an accessible location for a future residence. An established farm lane winds through the countryside, passing a 4.3-acre lower agricultural field before climbing toward the property's impressive upper elevations. The centerpiece of this offering is a magnificent 17.6-acre upper agricultural field showcasing breathtaking panoramic views of surrounding valleys, wooded hillsides, and distant ridgelines. This elevated landscape offers an extraordinary setting for a dream home, cabin, or private retreat, where colorful autumn foliage and changing seasons create an ever-changing backdrop. The open acreage also provides opportunities for continued agricultural use, pasture, wildlife food plots, or outdoor recreation. Beyond the fields, the landscape transitions into beautiful mixed hardwood and evergreen forests, offering privacy, natural wildlife habitat, and excellent hunting opportunities. Rolling terrain, wooded slopes, natural cover, and the transition between fields and forest create desirable habitat for whitetail deer, wild turkey, and other wildlife. The established farm lane provides convenient access through portions of the acreage for hunting, hiking, and exploring.
Conveniently located along NYS Route 242 near Little Valley and Ellicottville, this remarkable property combines peaceful country living with access to four-season recreation, skiing, restaurants, and shopping. Whether establishing a secluded hilltop estate, family retreat, working agricultural property, or premier hunting destination, these 73.8 acres offer an exceptional combination of natural beauty, privacy, and opportunity. Tower blind not included.
